description: This file defines a React component 'InsertBlock' for a rich text editor toolbar, providing various block insertion options such as headings, code blocks, images, tables, and embeds, with mobile and desktop variations. It includes menu item definitions and UI interactions for inserting different content blocks into the editor.

methods.name: horizontalRule
methods.description: Creates a menu item for inserting a horizontal rule in the editor.

methods.name: codeblock
methods.description: Creates a menu item for toggling a code block in the editor.

methods.name: blockquote
methods.description: Creates a menu item for toggling a blockquote in the editor.

methods.name: mathblock
methods.description: Creates a menu item for inserting a math/formula block.

methods.name: callout
methods.description: Creates a menu item for inserting a callout with different types.

methods.name: image
methods.description: Creates a menu item for inserting images, with options for upload, camera, and URL.

methods.name: table
methods.description: Creates a menu item for inserting tables, including CSV import and size selection.

methods.name: embedMobile
methods.description: Creates a menu item for inserting embedded content on mobile.

methods.name: embedDesktop
methods.description: Creates a menu item for inserting embedded content on desktop.

methods.name: attachment
methods.description: Creates a menu item for attaching files.

methods.name: tasklist
methods.description: Creates a menu item for toggling task list blocks.

methods.name: outlinelist
methods.description: Creates a menu item for toggling outline list blocks.

methods.name: uploadImageFromURLMobile
methods.description: Creates a menu item for uploading images via URL on mobile.

methods.name: uploadImageFromURL
methods.description: Creates a menu item for uploading images via URL on desktop.
